decision: Keep as a bounded independent model test; do not select as an overall photographic improvement. No second full-frame adjustment.

interpretation: This image does not establish that uncoupled lighting was the only cause of the gap, or that the atmospheric model is invalid. The brightness anchor and photographed atmospheric/camera response remain unmeasured.
